games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary: Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: End of Abyss
games.summary: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Hell Is Us
games.summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts III is the third main installment in the Kingdom Hearts series developed and published by Square Enix. It was initially released January 2019 for the PlayStation 4 and the Xbox One. An expansion, Kingdom Hearts III Re Mind was released in January 2020.

The story takes place after the events of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. It features an older Sora as the main protagonist, who sets forth on a new adventure to search for seven guardians of light in an attempt to stop Xehanort from bringing about a second Keyblade War. Sora is joined by Donald Duck, Goofy, Mickey Mouse,

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Mafia III
games.summary: Mafia III is an open-world action-adventure game played from a third-person perspective and the third entry in the Mafia series. Players control Lincoln Clay across a large recreation of the fictional city of New Bordeaux, modeled on New Orleans, tackling missions with a mix of gunplay, melee combat, stealth, and a cover system. Objectives can be approached in different ways, and players seize territory from rival criminal outfits and hand districts to their lieutenants. Period cars can be driven across the city, and the setting and licensed soundtrack draw heavily on the late 1960s American S

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.summary: "Guardian, gather the pieces of the great relic and seal the void of darkness." In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. Start your journey as a guardian, gather pieces of great relic and close the void.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

On your journey, you’ll be joined by Pawns, mysterious otherworldly beings, in an adventure so unique you will feel as if accompanied by other players while on your own adventure.

All of these elements are elevated further by the latest in graphics, artificial intelligence (AI) and physics technology to create a truly immersive fantasy world in Dragon's Dogma 2.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: We Are So Cooked
games.summary: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to Modern Warfare III (2023), continuing the rebooted Modern Warfare storyline. The campaign is set during a North Korean invasion of South Korea and features dual perspectives: a young South Korean soldier named Private Park facing his first combat deployment, and Captain Price operating outside official channels on a personal mission. The game also includes multiplayer with 6v6 core maps, large-scale vehicle combat maps, and a dynamic map system called Kill Block that reshapes layouts between rounds. A DMZ extraction

games.name: Resident Evil 2
games.summary: Resident Evil 2 is a remake of 1998's Resident Evil 2. The game was not developed with the intent of improving the original, but rather a reimagining of the original story with redesigned maps, characters and story elements. Gameplay mechanics are more similar to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard though with the use of an over-the-shoulder camera.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixelart world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Mixtape
games.summary: Mixtape is a narrative adventure game developed by Beethoven & Dinosaur and published by Annapurna Interactive. Set during the last night of high school, it follows three friends as they revisit memories connected to music, youth and leaving home. The game combines story scenes with playable vignettes, including skating, parties, and other moments, all framed by a licensed soundtrack.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: Sword of the Sea
games.summary:
Sword of the Sea is an action-adventure game developed by Giant Squid, the studio behind Abzû and The Pathless.

Set in a vast desert landscape, players control a character known as the Wraith, exploring ruins and uncovering a lost world. Movement is centered on the "Hoversword," a tool that combines surfing, skateboarding, and snowboarding mechanics. The game emphasizes fluid traversal, atmospheric exploration, and light puzzle-solving.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

games.name: Fart Together
games.summary: Fart Together is a physics-based parkour game where 1–4 players steer the same boat using fart power. Play alone or with friends and coordinate your direction, timing, and gas power to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

games.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
games.summary: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

games.name: Truck World: Australia
games.summary: Travel across Australia behind the wheel of the mighty Road Train! Haul extreme cargo thousands of miles and explore the Outback's wilderness in some of the most intense conditions on earth!

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

games.name: Stellar Blade
games.summary: Stellar Blade is a third-person action-adventure game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Players control Eve, an elite soldier deployed from an orbital colony to reclaim the planet from hostile creatures called Naytibas. The combat system emphasizes timing-based parrying and evasion, with skill gauges that unlock powerful attacks and buffs. The game features exploration across ruined environments, side quests from NPC survivors in the last human city of Xion, and a narrative with multiple endings based on player choices.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: Herdling
games.summary: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Rockstar Games. Set in the fictional U.S. state of Leonida, which includes Vice City and its surrounding regions, the game follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, two criminals who become involved in a statewide conspiracy after a robbery goes wrong. Players can switch between the two protagonists while exploring the open world and completing story missions involving criminal activities, armed confrontations, and encounters with law enforcement. Gameplay combines driving, third-person combat, and exploration, plus optional

games.name: Terminus: Day Zero
games.summary: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

games.name: No Asteroids
games.summary: No Asteroids is a first-person incremental mining game set on an asteroid on a collision course with Earth. Players have 90 days to excavate 5,000,000 cubic metres of rock, sell the ore and upgrade their tools and ship-mounted weapons. Mining equipment progresses from a pickaxe to homing missile swarms, while automated ship guns help break apart the asteroid. The campaign can be played solo or in online co-op with up to eight players, with a shared economy and progression saved by the host.

games.name: Food Devils
games.summary: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Strategy-RPG Roguelike.

games.name: Shred a Billion
games.summary: Shred a Billion is a first-person 3D incremental game about shredding a billion dollars. A bank vault is buried under a mountain of cash, and the player digs it out and feeds every bill to a giant shredder: first by hand, then with a bucket, a shovel, a vacuum, a jetpack and a fleet of up to 16 mining drones. Shredded money buys upgrades and proficiency nodes, golden bills grant temporary boosts, and hidden relics give permanent bonuses. The vault descends five terraces, with a secret waiting under the last layer of cash. The game can be played solo or in online co-op for up to four players wh

games.name: Rekindled
games.summary: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

games.name: My Child New Beginnings
games.summary: My Child New Beginnings is a life simulation game where you play as an adoptive parent to a child with a dramatic past. The game is a sequel to My Child Lebensborn and combines philosophy, trauma, care and reconciliation as the main topics. There will also be a simple online function that lets other people share thoughts about these topics.

games.name: Arctic Drive
games.summary: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

games.name: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
games.summary: In this cozy management lifesim, care for cute cats & customers while exploring a bustling folkloric city. Build the cat cafe of your dreams and fill hearts with delight using the power of cats, coffee and community

games.name: Me and You
games.summary: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

games.name: Reshine
games.summary: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: Shark Mart
games.summary: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

games.name: Grave Mistakes
games.summary: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

games.name: Flak Simulator
games.summary: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!

games.name: Split Brain Samsara
games.summary:
You and your friend are locked in the same body!
In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure!
Communication will be key!

games.name: Arkheron
games.summary: Arkheron is a fast-paced, isometric PvP where every item you grab rewrites how you play mid-fight. Take two friends up the Tower, pull off strats that shouldn’t work, and fight your way to the next floor.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: 10 Million Pixels
games.summary: Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

games.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
games.summary: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

games.name: Carry On Together
games.summary: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

games.name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
games.summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

games.name: Lost Camp
games.summary: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

games.name: MeowFactory
games.summary: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

games.name: Orion Blue
games.summary: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary: Winx Club: The Magic is Back is an adventure game set in the Winx universe, in which players take on the role of Bloom and explore the Magic Dimension in an original story. Players can transform and fly freely through an open world featuring familiar locations such as Alfea, Cloud Tower, Red Fountain, and Magix City, while solving puzzles, battling enemies, and uncovering secrets. The story revolves around the Festival of the 100 Moons, which is disrupted by a mysterious threat. Beyond the main adventure, the game features 32 challenges across four game modes and offers up to 24 playable chara

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

games.name: The Brave Few
games.summary: The Brave Few is a combined-arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few who fought in combat during World War II.

games.name: The Few
games.summary: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

games.name: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
games.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Silicone Heart
games.summary: Survive on a junkyard planet filled with broken robots, machinery, and resources in this adventure sandbox game. Recycle resources, repair robots, invent items, create new plant species, grow them, and uncover the mysteries of this planet.

games.name: Dumpster Gang
games.summary: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Debauchery & Magic
games.summary: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion wit

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

games.name: Apple Crumble
games.summary: Its your grandmas 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and dont worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.

games.name: Freestyle Football 2
games.summary: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

games.name: Quadrillion Carrots
games.summary: Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and g

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Dirt Town
games.summary: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players.

games.name: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
games.summary: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Unharvest
games.summary: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows and upgrade your plagues as the land slowly dies. How far can the decay reach?

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Did You See That?
games.summary: A 2 player psychological horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

games.name: Mik
games.summary: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.

games.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
games.summary: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

games.name: Guns of Eschaton
games.summary: The worlds first soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-opgo West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

games.name: Never Be Alone
games.summary: Dive into the post-apocalyptic realm of 'Never Be Alone,' an expansive open-world game designed for both solo and multiplayer experiences. In this zombie survival adventure, you can seamlessly team up with friends or brave the dangers alone.

games.name: Don't Fret
games.summary: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

games.name: Replaced
games.summary: Replaced is a 2.5D sci-fi retro-futuristic action platformer where you play as R.E.A.C.H. - an artificial intelligence trapped in a human body against its own will. Replaced combines cinematic platforming, pixel art and free-flow action combat set in an alternative 1980's.

games.name: Wish Upon a Llama
games.summary: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG created by Grinding Gear Games. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading. Path of Exile 2 is a free-to-play online multiplayer game with co-op for up to six players.

games.name: Silver Palace
games.summary: Silver Palace is an upcoming open‑world detective action‑adventure RPG developed by Silver Studio and published by Elementa worldwide. It is set in the sprawling Victorian‑style metropolis of Sylvanea, built upon the revolutionary element known as Silver Liquid that has fueled its industrial and social transformation. Players assume the role of a detective tasked with unraveling complex criminal conspiracies and uncovering hidden truths scattered throughout the city. The game seamlessly blends open‑world exploration with dynamic real‑time combat, featuring character switching, skill combos, an

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Sakura no Uta: To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms
games.summary: SCA-DI's award-winning visual novel masterpiece is finally available in English and in full HD! Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
games.summary: A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

games.name: Ember & Blade
games.summary:
Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that
reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

games.name: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
games.summary: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

games.name: Terranigma
games.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Flask
games.summary: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven: Collector's Edition
games.summary:
Stranger Than Heaven Collector's Edition includes:

Stranger Than Heaven Base Game (PlayStation 5)
Deluxe Upgrade & Pre-Order Bonus DLC Codes
Exclusive SteelBook Case
Exclusive 12-Inch Vinyl Record
Exclusive Collector’s Edition Box

games.name: Ananta
games.summary: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Polyaris
games.summary: Polyaris is a single-player, first-person survival skiing game set in a post-nuclear, procedurally generated Arctic world. Survive the cold, ski through icy wastelands, find essential resources, fight enemies, and uncover the mystery of why you are the last one alive.

games.name: Titan Quest II
games.summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

games.name: Arizona Sunshine
games.summary: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.name: UvsU: You vs. You
games.summary: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.summary: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

games.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
games.summary: You play as the queen of ants, managing an anthill. Ants cannot be controlled directly, but you can create the necessary types of ants; improve them; organize raids, build a dungeon! The goal of each level is to destroy all enemy bases.

games.name: Prison of Husks
games.summary: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary: Experience the thrills and pitfalls of school-life in Witchbrook! Discover a spellbinding isometric pixel art world full of charm and intrigue in this richly detailed magical school and town life simulator.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
games.summary: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.summary: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Cleaner Company
games.summary: You have officially joined the elite team of "Star Wipers"! Your mission? Cleaning! Alongside your trusted crew, you will embark on exciting expeditions to abandoned space stations, ruined restaurants in the cosmos, and unexplored planets.

games.name: Fate/Extra Record
games.summary:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew…

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.summary:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

games.name: Metroid Ravenous
games.summary: It’s eat or be eaten! Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.summary: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

games.name: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
games.summary: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

games.name: Metro 2039
games.summary:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

The year is 2039. For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow.

Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the su

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.summary: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.summary: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX
games.summary: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!

games.name: Among Us Story: On Guard
games.summary: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.summary: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journe

games.name: Persona 4 Revival: Digital Premium Edition
games.summary:
Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set

Persona 3 Reload BGMs include:
1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.)
2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry
3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.)

Persona 5 Royal BGMs include:
1. Dungeon BGM: The Whims of Fate
2. Normal Battle BGM: Will Power
3. Result BGM: Triumph

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.summary: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

games.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.summary: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

games.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.summary: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trines iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Eternal Anima
games.summary: Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offense in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilizations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

games.name: Gundam Rogue Orbit
games.summary: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.summary: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Trainwatch
games.summary: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

games.name: Road Kings
games.summary: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

games.name: Phase Zero
games.summary: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Two survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and escape the town in this classic survival horror. Can you make it till dawn?

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: ReVamp
games.summary: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.summary:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dyn

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Step forward into Exodus — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Stronghold 4
games.summary: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

games.name: Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
games.summary: Melty Blood: Type Lumina is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

games.name: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
games.summary: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

games.name: God of War Laufey
games.summary: God of War: Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio for PlayStation 5. The game follows Laufey, also known as Faye, after she awakens in a strange afterlife realm following her death. To protect Kratos and Atreus, she travels through the Everywhen, an afterlife of the gods where deities from different mythologies compete for power. The game shifts the focus from Kratos to Faye and features sword-based combat, magic, and new supporting characters.

games.name: LEGO Skylines
games.summary: Build what only you can in LEGO Skylines. In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space. And there’s just one rule. Make it yours.

games.name: Turok: Origins
games.summary: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.
